visualCharacteristics.purpose: Simple sign-up form such as the "Stay in touch" newsletter form
visualCharacteristics.description: Forms keep the name form; generate with forms-excat:excat-form-block-handler (skill not available in this session) Page background; centered heading/intro then a sign-up form (first/last name, email, select, opt-in checkbox, reCAPTCHA, Submit).

contentPattern.note: Forms keep the name form; build via forms-excat:excat-form-block-handler
contentPattern.structure: one row per field: Label | Type (text, email, tel, number, date, textarea, select, checkbox, submit) | Placeholder or options (select: comma- or line-separated) | Required (yes); config rows with Type "action" (submission URL in cell 3) and "success" (message in cell 1). Alternatively a single link to a spreadsheet JSON with columns Label, Name, Type, Placeholder, Options, Mandatory

usage: Newsletter / register-your-interest sign-up. reCAPTCHA from the source is not reproduced.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for short lead-capture forms that POST JSON to an endpoint. For complex adaptive forms use a dedicated forms solution.
